Vasistas affiche chaque application Wind: Vasistas shows each Windows app in its own window on your Linux desktop. This assistant checks the computer's configuration, installs Windows, then installs the apps.
Activez la virtualisation (SVM ou VT-x): Turn on virtualisation (SVM or VT-x) in the BIOS, run the command sudo usermod -aG kvm $USER, then log out and log in again.

{version}, {language}, avec un compte lo: {version}, {language}, with a local account (no Microsoft account).
Choisissez l'offre de votre abonnement o: Choose the plan of your subscription or licence. Office installs in the Windows language and activates the first time it opens. The Install page in Vasistas then offers other versions, languages and add-ons (Visio, Project).
Vos applications Windows sont dans le me: Your Windows apps are in the Applications menu.
Dans Vasistas, la page Applications perm: In Vasistas, the Apps page lets you choose which apps are shown in the menu and install others. The Files page sets which Linux folders Windows can see and which document types open with Windows. The Display page sets the balance between battery life and smoothness.
Choisissez la version et la langue de Wi: Choose the Windows version and language, then the licensing mode. Evaluation versions download directly from Microsoft; for the others, Vasistas opens Microsoft's official page, then you choose the downloaded ISO file.
Recherche du lien de téléchargement chez: Looking up the download link at Microsoft…
Sans clé, Windows s'installe dans l'édit: Without a key, Windows installs in the chosen edition and runs with an activation reminder until you enter your key (Settings, System, Activation). A valid Windows licence is still required: the generic key published by Microsoft only selects the edition during installation.
Image choisie dans vos fichiers : vérifi: Image chosen from your files: check that it matches the chosen version and language.
Image d'installation à télécharger depui: Installation image to download from Microsoft's page (5 to 8 GB)
Cliquez sur « Ouvrir la page de Microsof: Click "Open Microsoft's Page", choose the "{language}" language and the 64-bit version, download the image, then click "Choose an ISO file…".
Tick what you want in Windows. Nothing is installed here: everything starts with a single click at the next step, from the publishers' servers.
Voir ce que fait Windows pendant l'insta: See what Windows is doing during installation, and answer it with the mouse and keyboard if needed
Vasistas enchaîne les étapes ci-dessus s: Vasistas runs the steps above one after another, with nothing for you to do. The computer stays usable meanwhile; allow 30 to 90 minutes depending on your choices.
Mettre Windows à jour à la fin de l'inst: Update Windows at the end of the installation
Comptez 20 à 60 minutes de plus. Sans ce: Allow 20 to 60 more minutes. Without this option, Windows Update can be started later from Vasistas.
Tout reste modifiable ensuite : la page: Everything can be changed later: the Install page of Vasistas adds or removes applications at any time.
Démarrage de Windows, puis installation: Starting Windows, then installing the Vasistas tools (shared folders, drivers).
Les mises à jour de Windows n'ont pas pu: Windows updates could not be installed ({error}): start Windows Update later from Vasistas.
20 à 40 minutes environ, avec deux redém: About 20 to 40 minutes, with two Windows restarts. No action is needed.
Recherche, téléchargement et installatio: Searching for, downloading and installing updates: 20 to 60 minutes.
Redémarrage de Windows pour terminer les: Restarting Windows to finish the updates.
